note: Family-run RV park within Whitecourt town limits, one minute off Hwy 43 beside the Athabasca River; a mix of large open pull-throughs and private treed sites, plus tent sites. Convenience store and gift shop, pedal-cart rentals, playground, 24-hour laundry. Rates are per RV, not per site. --Claude
